# Scene Studio demonstration image

`scene-demo.png` is an **AI-generated demo, not a camera photograph**. It was generated for Luma Studio on 2026-11-01 using the built-in image-generation tool, with no user photograph or external image-library input. The generated PNG was copied unmodified into this project.

It is intended for reviewing foliage recoloring, sky masks, season overlays and lamp relighting. Its two glass globes reflect daytime light; they are represented as unlit lamps. Do not describe this synthetic scene as real-world evidence or as a benchmark of physical relighting accuracy.

## Exact generated prompt

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape daytime demonstration image for a professional photo editor's scene transformation tests. Create one natural photographic-style image in a 3:2 landscape composition, approximately 1536x1024 pixels. Scene: a quiet attractive public park on a clear spring afternoon. A gently curving pale gray stone path leads from the foreground toward the center distance, framed by abundant genuinely green leafy deciduous trees and a little green grass. The upper third has a clearly blue sky with several soft white clouds; leave visible open sky between the tree crowns. Exactly two clearly visible UNLIT black metal park lamp posts, one on each side of the path, at foreground-to-middle distance. Each lamp has one large pale frosted glass globe, unmistakably off, with natural daylight reflections but no emitted glow. Put one small adult park visitor at mid-distance, facing away and walking farther down the path, modest ordinary clothing; no other people. Soft directional natural afternoon daylight, mild realistic contact shadows, restrained color, visible fine leaf texture and natural depth. Keep both whole lamp globes clearly within frame, roughly in the middle half vertically, with dark posts distinguishable from foliage. Realistic optics and photographic detail, no exaggerated HDR or artificial neon. The image should be suitable for testing green foliage to autumn colors, winter snow overlays and daytime-to-night lamp relighting. No text, no logo, no watermark, no frames, no graphic UI. This is an AI-generated demo scene, not a camera photograph.
